title: Fur Brush for Dyson Vacuums – Brush and Vacuum in the Same Stroke
descriptionHtml:
The fur gets brushed out – and lands on the floor

The dog sheds, the brush fills up, and everything you've combed out drifts down onto the rug you just vacuumed. Two chores that undo each other.

The brush that sits on the vacuum

A brush head that connects to the Dyson V7, V8, V10, V11 or V15 – with hose and adapters in the kit. The tines loosen the undercoat and the machine sucks it up in the same stroke. The fur ends up in the bin, not on the floor.

Features

  • The fur ends up in the vacuum – not on the floor you just cleaned
  • Fits your Dyson – V7, V8, V10, V11 and V15 with the included adapters
  • The hose gives you reach – brush on the sofa without lifting the machine
  • Gentle tines – loosen undercoat without pulling on the skin

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
